title: Ate it and Plan it turn blue while their calendar is open: an action looks like a chosen choice
short: An action stays white; blue with a tick is for what is chosen
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
boardTitle: B151: Ate it turns blue while its calendar is open, so an action looks like a status
from: Coach Milan, 18 November 2026, 19:51, looking at the boards and the app.
words: I see Ate it as a blue chip. Is it a button or a status? If it is eaten, then it should be with a checkmark, and if it is to be selected it should be with a white background.
problem: At the end of a plate I tap Ate it. Its calendar opens and the button turns blue. Blue is the look of a chosen choice, and there is no tick. It reads as eaten, and nothing is eaten yet. Plan it does the same.
rule: Your rule from the board DT310: a choice is white until chosen, then blue with a tick. An action is a button and stays as it is. Ate it and Plan it are actions.
proposed: Ate it and Plan it stay white, also while their calendar is open. The calendar under the buttons shows what is open. Nothing else changes.

ac.title: Ate it stays white
ac.text: Given a plate with no meal set, when I tap Ate it and its calendar opens, then Ate it has the same white look as before the tap.

ac.title: Plan it stays white
ac.text: Given the same plate, when I tap Plan it and its calendar opens, then Plan it has the same white look as before the tap.

ac.title: The second tap still closes
ac.text: Given Ate it's calendar is open, when I tap Ate it again, then the calendar closes.

ac.title: Blue with a tick is for the chosen
ac.text: Given the calendar is open with Dinner as the guess, when I look at it, then Dinner's row is blue with a tick, and no button above it is blue.

unchanged: What Save it, Plan it and Ate it do.
The marked meal in the calendar: blue with a tick.
Ate it on Did you eat it? for a plate from earlier: it is the main button there, filled blue, and stays so.
details: A look only. No new element and no new words.
The screen B151b is what it looks like.
